label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is url = v.toString() where v comes from session.getAttribute('partnerCallback'). Although there are guards (startsWith('https://') and contains(suffix)), the url ultimately derives from session data that could be attacker-controlled. The https:// prefix check and suffix containment provide partial mitigation but do not eliminate the vulnerability since an attacker with session access could craft a URL passing both checks. Case TP: at least one alert-TP.

evidence.note: url derived from session attribute v.toString(), redirected via sendRedirect with only https:// and suffix checks
